options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: annotations
options.description: Allows clients to store small amounts of arbitrary data. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.

options.name: bitbucket_cloud_config
options.description: Configuration for connections to Bitbucket Cloud.

options.name: bitbucket_data_center_config
options.description: Configuration for connections to Bitbucket Data Center.

options.name: disabled
options.description: If disabled is set to true, functionality is disabled for this connection. Repository based API methods and webhooks processing for repositories in this connection will be disabled.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: github_enterprise_config
options.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of GitHub Enterprise.

options.name: gitlab_config
options.description: Configuration for connections to gitlab.com or an instance of GitLab Enterprise.

options.name: location
options.description: The location for the resource. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: name
options.description: The resource name of the connection. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.
